entries.subject: Size: JPL Small-Body Database diameter
entries.finding: 5145 Pholus (1992 AD) is drawn as a sphere at the 190 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists, with JPL's stated reference Earth, Moon, and Planets, v. 89, Issue 1, p. 117-134 (2002). No shape model is published, so the sphere is illustrative.
